REC-4881 Phase 1b/2 Study On October 15, 2026, we announced updated topline data from our Phase 1b/2 TUPELO study of REC-4881, an investigational MEK1/2 inhibitor for familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) that targets both Wnt/β-catenin initiation and MAPK evolution pathways via a mechanism identified by Recursion's AI discovery platform.
